evidence: The generated-only video is 1248x298, exactly 240 frames at 24 FPS, and 10.0 seconds with SHA-256 3f336c3d2af7549e6a9f6579bfad6c4dbe736ffc9a9d1e68cd930c88218e1d67.
Its three panels contain only the accepted handover, unscrew-cap, and rinsing-pose generated candidates; no real-source panel is displayed.
The v2 delivery manifest retains hashes for both the generated-only comparison and the 2x2 provenance comparison.
lessons: Keep the real source available for provenance, but make generated-only panels the primary artifact when the acceptance question is human-residual removal.
limitations: The action and physical-scope limitations are unchanged from the accepted evaluation.
next_actions: Use the generated-only artifact as the demo-page and user-facing default.
